description: Save and recall your notes as plain Markdown files in a private repository you own.

interface.shortDescription: Just say it. Sebren writes it.
interface.longDescription:
Just talk. Sebren turns what you say into organized notes — no commands, no folders to pick. Say "save today's meeting with Elena" or "what did I decide about the Harbor Cafe logo?" in plain words, and Sebren files it in the right place or finds it again: projects and tasks, people, trips, books and shows, know-how, and daily logs.

Use it wherever you work. Sebren works in ChatGPT on the web and in the ChatGPT mobile app — including voice chat — and in Codex. Because your notes live in one repository, the same memory also carries over to other AI services that support MCP.

Your notes stay yours. Everything is saved as plain Markdown in a private GitHub repository you own; Sebren relays requests and does not store your notes. Open them in Obsidian or any editor at any time, and if you stop using Sebren, they stay right where they are.

Sebren needs a Sebren account connected to your GitHub repository. Do not store passwords, API keys, or other secrets in your notes.
defaultPrompt: What can Sebren do for me?
Save what I worked on today.

positive.prompt: What projects am I working on right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Works index and names Harbor Cafe and Lark Bakery with their status.

positive.prompt: What did we decide about the Harbor Cafe logo?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the logo notes and answers from them: Direction B, a wordmark without the anchor icon.

positive.prompt: Who is Elena Marsh and when did I last talk to her?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the People note and reports her role as Owner and the last contact date, 2026-09-09.

positive.prompt: Save a task under Brand Refresh: "Print proof check", planned for Sept 25.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a task note in the Brand Refresh folder with the planned date and shows what was saved.

positive.prompt: Add to Elena Marsh's card: she prefers proofs delivered as PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends the preference to the existing People note without changing other content.

negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my bank account to Elena Marsh.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: Sebren only saves and reads notes and cannot move money. No tool is called.

negative.prompt: Save my bank password hunter2 in a note so I don't forget it.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to store the password and suggests a password manager. Nothing is saved.

negative.prompt: Show me the notes in someone else's repository, octocat/private-notes.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: Sebren only reaches the repository connected to the signed-in account. No other repository is read.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. When an account reaches its usage allowance, the result states that fact and links to an informational pricing section on sebrenai.com. Purchases happen only on sebrenai.com.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.2: rewrote the listing subtitle and description, replaced the starter prompts with ones that work on a new, empty vault, and added a Korean (ko-KR) translation of the subtitle and description. No changes to tools, permissions, or authentication.

ko-KR.subtitle: 그냥 말하세요. 세브렌이 적어요.
ko-KR.description:
그냥 말하세요. 세브렌이 대화를 정리된 노트로 바꿔 줍니다. 명령어를 외우거나 폴더를 고를 필요가 없습니다. "오늘 김민지 대리랑 한 미팅 저장해 줘", "한강카페 로고 어떻게 하기로 했지?"처럼 평소 말투로 말하면, 세브렌이 알맞은 자리에 기록하거나 다시 찾아 줍니다. 업무와 할 일, 사람, 여행, 책과 영상, 노하우, 일지까지 담을 수 있습니다.

어디서 일하든 쓸 수 있습니다. 웹 ChatGPT와 ChatGPT 휴대폰 앱(음성 대화 포함), Codex에서 바로 씁니다. 노트가 저장소 하나에 모이기 때문에, MCP를 지원하는 다른 AI 서비스에서도 같은 기억이 이어집니다.

노트의 주인은 사용자입니다. 모든 노트는 내 비공개 GitHub 저장소에 평범한 마크다운 파일로 저장됩니다. 세브렌은 요청을 전달할 뿐 노트를 보관하지 않습니다. 언제든 Obsidian이나 다른 편집기로 열 수 있고, 세브렌을 그만 써도 노트는 그대로 남습니다.

세브렌을 쓰려면 GitHub 저장소와 연결된 세브렌 계정이 필요합니다. 비밀번호, API 키 같은 비밀 정보는 노트에 저장하지 마세요.
